verdict.rationale: Elicit documents automation-like features such as Skills, Routines, and Alerts, so this axis applies. However, no evidence shows version history, change review, or rollback for these automations. API URL versioning (v1/v2) and 30-day recovery of deleted papers are different capabilities and do not count toward versioning or rolling back user automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
